integration.variable_pattern_description: Matches ${VARIABLE} or ${VARIABLE:Label} format. Variable name can contain any alphanumeric characters. Label after colon is optional and can be empty.

global_runtime_variables.name: OLD_STATE
global_runtime_variables.description: JSON representation of the entity's state before the event. Empty for CREATE events. Contains the entity object (Gateway, User, etc.) for UPDATE and DELETE events; a user carries only user_id, role, status, is_primary, created_at and updated_at.

global_runtime_variables.name: NEW_STATE
global_runtime_variables.description: JSON representation of the entity's state after the event. Empty for DELETE events. Contains the entity object (Gateway, User, etc.) for CREATE and UPDATE events; a user carries only user_id, role, status, is_primary, created_at and updated_at.

global_runtime_variables.name: EVENT_TYPE
global_runtime_variables.description: The type of event that triggered the integration (e.g., 'gateway.created', 'user.updated', etc.)

global_runtime_variables.name: TIMESTAMP
global_runtime_variables.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the event occurred

categories.name: Governance Audit
categories.description: Forwards every record written to the VP Audit Log: policy decisions, trust checks, VP injections, credential delegation and payment events. Requires the audit.view permission.

event_types.name: Policy Decision
event_types.description: A gateway, surface, MCP-tool or response OPA policy allowed or denied a request

event_types.name: Trust Check
event_types.description: A TRQP trust-check outcome for the caller or target leg

event_types.name: Trace Terminated
event_types.description: A surface terminated the end-to-end trace at its egress

event_types.name: VP Injected
event_types.description: A signed identity Verifiable Presentation was injected into a proxied request or response

event_types.name: Token Injected
event_types.description: A delegated credential from the vault was injected on the caller's behalf

event_types.name: Token Refreshed
event_types.description: An expired delegated credential was refreshed and injected

event_types.name: Refresh Failed
event_types.description: A delegated credential could not be refreshed, so consent is required again

event_types.name: Consent Granted
event_types.description: A user completed the OAuth consent flow and a delegation token was stored

event_types.name: Consent Required
event_types.description: The caller was asked to grant consent before the request could proceed

event_types.name: Token Revoked
event_types.description: A delegation token was revoked through the management API

event_types.name: User Tokens Revoked
event_types.description: Every delegation token for a user was revoked

event_types.name: Token Not Found
event_types.description: A delegation token lookup found no match

event_types.name: Elicitation Sent
event_types.description: An MCP elicitation request was sent to the client

event_types.name: Elicitation Accepted
event_types.description: The client accepted an MCP elicitation

event_types.name: Elicitation Declined
event_types.description: The client declined an MCP elicitation

event_types.name: Elicitation Cancelled
event_types.description: The client cancelled an MCP elicitation

event_types.name: Elicitation Timed Out
event_types.description: The client did not answer an MCP elicitation in time

event_types.name: Pre-Authorize Blocked
event_types.description: Pre-authorization blocked a session because a required credential was missing

event_types.name: Payment Event
event_types.description: An x402 or MPP payment lifecycle event (challenge, verification, settlement)
